highlights: Recover Dashboard updates blocked by an interrupted OpenClaw migration after a manual gateway rescue.
Preserve native Codex runtime homes during maintenance snapshots and rollback, including temporary command symlinks.
Allow slower OpenClaw startup preflight and recover interrupted or repeated gateway-rescue operations.
Explicit root-only recovery preserves the original migration record and rescue evidence before restarting the gateway.
Includes the 5.0.3 fix for false OpenClaw authentication-store readiness failures.
